results.title: Tenant admin member directory: metadata, tenant-scoped candidates (search, limit, exclusions), add through the UI, isolation and rules

checks.name: [api] GET members: every row has userId, username, displayName, email, role, active
[api] …and the metadata is right (adminA: its username and display name)
[api] candidates: 200, a list of {userId, username, displayName, email}
[api] a former member in a workspace of the tenant (adminB) IS a candidate
[api] current members are not candidates (adminA)
[api] a SYSTEM_ADMIN account (activated, enabled, a workspace member, former tenant member) is never a candidate
[api] a non-activated account and a disabled account are not candidates
[api] at most 50 results, sorted by username
[api] search q finds adminB by part of the username and only matching people
[api] a 1-character search is refused (400 QUERY_TOO_SHORT)
[api] a search with no match is an empty list
[fact] 'a user known only to ANOTHER tenant is invisible' cannot be built through the public API; it is C1's backend test TenantMemberDirectoryTests
Công ty của tôi: the member rows show names and emails from the member metadata
typing the search shows adminB (name · email) in the candidate list, and not the SYSTEM_ADMIN / disabled / non-activated accounts
add candidate: the server lists adminB as an active MEMBER, with metadata
the member appears in the table with his name
the candidate disappears after the add (API and picker)
[api] a guessed foreign UUID → 404 USER_NOT_FOUND
[api] adding that SYSTEM_ADMIN account by id → 404 (not eligible, no oracle)
[api] a non-activated account cannot be added by id (404); a RELATED but disabled account is refused with its own code (422 USER_DISABLED, C1 cf0c962)
[api] a caller from ANOTHER tenant gets 404 for members, candidates and add
[api] changing your own tenant role → 403 SELF_GRANT_FORBIDDEN
no unexpected 4xx/5xx from the portal's calls
no unhandled page errors

results.title: App creator (EDITOR, made by the tenant admin): Studio login → project visible → edit / save / reload → permissions are the role's
results.reason: the Studio portal refuses this creator at login (/auth/no-access) although /auth/me lists the workspace with []. The API side of the same account works (project APIs, edit, persist, no publish). H-C1-04 (still open).

checks.name: [api] the workspace admin creates a project in the new workspace (201)
[api] …and adds the creator to the project as EDITOR (member route)
[api] the creator's resolved project permissions include APP_EDIT and NOT APP_PUBLISH
[api] …and no MEMBER_MANAGE: /auth/me lists none in the workspace
[api] an edit by the creator is accepted (200)
after a reload the edit is still there (persisted)
[api] publishing is refused for the creator (403): the role is the role
